_note: Only ERROR-level findings individually verified as false-positives or intentional/vestigial are suppressed. Non-blocking warnings/info are NOT baselined. Never bulk-baseline.

suppressions.reason: False positive. roadmap_send_digest is a WP-Cron hook (const CRON_HOOK) scheduled via wp_schedule_event in class-roadmap-pro-digest.php; WP-Cron fires it, not an explicit do_action, so the static audit cannot see the fire site.
